valuation/ndx_pe_trailing.csv.original_source: Siblis Research (2016-12 onward); Nasdaq Index Research (1999-12, 2000-12, 2019-04-30)

valuation/ndx_pe_trailing.csv.definition: trailing P/E = aggregate constituent market cap / aggregate trailing 12-month earnings (Siblis: normalised net income, one-offs removed)
valuation/ndx_pe_trailing.csv.coverage: sparse: Nasdaq points for 1999-12, 2000-12 and 2019-04-30; Siblis year-ends 2016-2025 and selected month-ends to 2026-10. No free continuous same-definition series was found

valuation/ndx_annual_pe_nasdaq_approx_20.original_source: Nasdaq, NDX Extended Presentation, December 2022, p.18 "Nasdaq-100 Index: Valuations vs. Long-Run History" (data as of 2022-12-30; Nasdaq, FactSet, Bloomberg)
valuation/ndx_annual_pe_nasdaq_approx_20.method: 2001 is the value printed on the chart (208.3); 2002-2022 are read from the vector path of the P/E line: PE = (433.200012 - y) * 150 / (433.200012 - 148.679993), one decimal. 2023-2024 estimates excluded
valuation/ndx_annual_pe_nasdaq_approx_20.definition: FY P/E as labelled on the chart; not confirmed to equal daily trailing 12-month P/E
valuation/ndx_annual_pe_nasdaq_approx_20.encoding: UTF-8 with BOM, Chinese column notes
